snippet.title: The Spell Brigade - Official Animated Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Don't miss the Animated Release Date Trailer for The Spell Brigade, a bullet-hell action co-op roguelite developed by Bolt Blaster Games. Players will assemble a team to take on hordes of enemies, attain new upgrades and synergies, and overcome challenges from run to run. The Spell Brigade is launching on April 29 for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).

#TheSpellBrigade #Gaming #IGN
